releases.title: In Tunez We Trust, Vol. 1
releases.note: DJ Tunez will be dropping a new EP titled "In Tunez We Trust" on November 13. The EP is set to include features from Wizkid, Seyi Vibez, Kemuel, Odumodublvck, Tay Iwar & Mannywellz.

releases.title: Time and Space
releases.note: Olamide will be dropping his 12th studio album "Time And Space" on November 16.

releases.title: Lavida Boy
releases.note: Joeboy will be dropping a new EP "Lavida Boy" on November 20. It will include the lead single "Pretty Girls".

releases.title: Oldest Young Man
releases.note: 2Baba will be dropping his first album in 6 years "Oldest Young Man" on November 27.

releases.title: Long Live, The Mayor
releases.note: Mayorkun will be dropping his new EP "Long Live, The Mayor" on November 30. The EP will include the lead singles "Kaluba" and "Home Training".
